name: Idol of False Gods — "it's a 0/0 creature in addition to its other types and it has annihilator 2"
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). The keyword after "in addition to its other types" was read only as "and has …"; with the pronoun repeated ("and it has annihilator 2") it was dropped. With eight +1/+1 counters the Idol is an 8/8 creature with annihilator 2.
